# Ultralytics YOLOv8-x-seg

Instance Segmentation · `yolov8-x-seg_640x640` · DX-APP C++ example

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolov8-x-seg-1
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov8-x-seg_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/yolov8-x-seg_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov8-x-seg_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/instance_segmentation/yolov8_seg/yolov8-x-seg_640x640/yolov8-x-seg_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov8-x-seg_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 45.40 |
| Q-Lite | 37.81 (−7.59) |
| Q-Pro | 38.37 (−7.03) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.

> **Note:** Q-Lite is 7.59 points below Raw on mAP.

> **Note:** Q-Pro is 7.03 points below Raw on mAP.
